cases.name: older French batch-sheet and plan titles get their anchors; a free-form heading is reported, not guessed
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/ma-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/.claude $R/todo/x $R/src/Acme.Application
printf '{"product":"Acme"}' > $R/.claude/kit.config.json
printf '## Deroulement TDD

## Politique et portees de test

## Constat
' > $R/todo/x/X-PLAN-F1.md
printf '## 3. Design DDD et Architecture
' > $R/todo/x/X-PLAN.md
cd $R && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/migrate-anchors.py --apply >/dev/null && cat todo/x/X-PLAN-F1.md todo/x/X-PLAN.md | grep -c 'kit:\(tdd-sequence\|test-policy\|ddd-design\)'
